title: Items
confidence: confirmed names and values / no slot or material links in the source
notes: 191 item templates in the sheet's own order and spelling.

The base value lives in the description, not in a field: the v1 Item shape has no value. Concept 11 gives an item template one, and the ticket that adds it can lift these numbers straight out — dagger 1000, breastplate 10000, all in copper.

No item names a material or an equipment slot. The sheet composes those at the point of use ("iron 1 empty rapier" in the main-hand box), so a slot assignment here would be our guess rather than the sheet's data. Concept 11's template/instance split is the fix.
Every item's stat-modifier columns are zero in this tab — bonuses come from the material, which is exactly Concept 11's "what a thing is, vs. what it is made of".
